This '''ship''' was the personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dranok]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanian]] partner [[Skarl]]. [[Technician/Legends|Mechanic]] [[Pergus Frode]] took shelter on this ship during an [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|outbreak]] at the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odacer-Faustin]].<ref name="Red Harvest" />
